description: MCP server providing 92 AI-optimized tools for .NET/C# semantic code analysis using Roslyn.
releaseNotes:
v1.6.3
Fixed:
- load_solution no longer silently drops projects it can't load. A partial load now reports partial:true, declaredProjectCount (from the solution file) alongside the loaded count, and loadFailures naming what failed - so it isn't mistaken for a clean load. health_check exposes the same without a reload; get_diagnostics gains analysisMode:"live-compilation" to signal its counts can differ from a dotnet build.
Full history: CHANGELOG.md in the repository.
